assumptions: SS_cons is WUSS notation (Rfam, Infernal); a Pfam file is refused because the same field holds protein states there.
Canonical and GU wobble pairs count as support.
limits: Measures support for the stated structure; it does not predict or fold one.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the stated pairs and how many rows form each, which the outputs carry; the MSA canvas draws them as a structure line and a support histogram and writes no reading over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which base pairs does a Stockholm alignment's consensus structure state, and how many aligned rows actually form each one?

description: Read the consensus RNA secondary structure a Stockholm alignment states in its `#=GC SS_cons` line (WUSS, the notation Rfam and Infernal write), and measure how well the aligned rows actually support it. Reports the base pairs, what each unpaired column is (hairpin, bulge, multifurcation, external, insertion, local end), and per pair the fraction of rows whose two bases form a canonical or GU wobble pair. Use it to check whether a family's published structure is borne out by the sequences, or to pull a pair table out of an alignment for drawing. Reading only, and it REFUSES a Pfam alignment by name: `SS_cons` is two alphabets, and Pfam writes protein DSSP states in the same field, where C/H/E are pseudoknot letters in WUSS — parsing one as the other would invent base pairs for a protein.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

text.description: the alignment file's contents. Stockholm is the only format that records `#=GC` annotation, so a CLUSTAL or PHYLIP file is refused by name rather than returning an empty structure.

name: read_structure_consensus

alphabet.description: which alphabet the `SS_cons` line was written in: `wuss`, `protein-dssp`, or `unknown`

medianSupport.description: the median, over pairs that any row spans, of the fraction of those rows forming a canonical or wobble pair. The panel's own headline number — a family whose structure is real sits high here, and a low value means the rows do not do what the annotation says

pairList.description: every pair as {i, j}, plus `knotLetter` when it came from a pseudoknot letter rather than a bracket

pairTable.description: per column, its partner column or -1 — the same shape `pairTable` returns, so it wires straight into an arc drawing

roles.description: per column, what its glyph said: pair, hairpin, bulge, multifurcation, external, insertion or missing

rows.description: aligned sequences the support was measured over

support.description: per column, {observed, paired} or null where the column is unpaired — the denominator travels so a caller can say "no evidence" instead of drawing a zero
